title: Nellis object as balloons drifting in the wind

tellings.quote: I think that's just a balloon or a bunch of balloons floating in the wind.

related.note: Same 1994 Nellis video as telling 8, but explained as balloons drifting in the wind.

plain: A 1994 video from the Nellis and Tonopah range, a military testing area in Nevada, shows an unexplained object, and the UFO skeptic Mick West says he thinks it is just a balloon or a bunch of balloons floating in the wind. He gives this as his own reading of the footage in a debate with Michels. If he is right, the video shows nothing unusual.
